threshold_policy: No universal operational targets. Applicable owner-approved floors, ceilings, margins and observation windows must be frozen before outcomes are inspected.

metrics.aggregation: Output-level coverage with critical exceptions retained
metrics.limits: Counts do not establish impact; preserve language, geography, beneficiaries and independent control functions.

metrics.numerator: Relevant incidents by severity and exposure type
metrics.denominator: Comparable exposure units appropriate to service
metrics.aggregation: Report counts, exposure and severity separately
metrics.limits: No observed incident does not establish safety; dependence and reporting completeness matter.

metrics.denominator: Capability required for same demand and contingency floor
metrics.aggregation: Capability by location/time and surge reserve
metrics.limits: Low utilization does not establish removable reserve.

metrics.numerator: Confirmed errors by severity, including failed tasks
metrics.denominator: All eligible completed, failed and pending service events
metrics.aggregation: Event-level severity and rework; independent operational units identified
metrics.limits: Do not remove failures or count repeated appearances as independent events.

metrics.numerator: Elapsed service times including outstanding-event censoring
metrics.denominator: All eligible ordinary and urgent requests
metrics.aggregation: Distribution and mandatory deadline breaches; urgent events separate
metrics.limits: Mean alone can hide tails; backlog and censoring must remain visible.

metrics.numerator: Accepted tested dependencies with documented custody
metrics.aggregation: Dependency-level acceptance before source capability removal
metrics.limits: Signed handover alone does not establish receiver performance.

metrics.numerator: Source retained plus receiver added plus parallel, overtime and contractor effort
metrics.denominator: Comparable completed service units at preserved quality
metrics.aggregation: Entities and work slices reconciled with full exception denominator
metrics.limits: Released hours are capacity; salary conversion does not demonstrate cash release.

metrics.numerator: Authenticated in-scope records with usable joins and authority receipts
metrics.denominator: Declared eligible population including missing and conflicting records
metrics.aggregation: Grain-specific coverage with missingness and selection mechanisms
metrics.limits: Complete rows do not prove factual truth, legal effect or causal identification.
